messages:
alex k: Morning — quick async standup. Hit an unexpected quota in GCP ap-southeast1 that blocked provisioning for Dedicated GPU pools this morning. Customers on APAC Dedicated saw pool scaling fail and canaries delayed. Investigating.

tess: ugh, seen that. Any error codes from the API? can you paste the request/response?

alex k: reply from quota API: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota 'nvidia_a100_gpus' exceeded for project". No neat rate-limit — it's a hard quota per project. Tried a manual increase request (submitted to cloud quota console) but approval could take hours.

pranav: copy. Are we talking region-level quota or global SKU quota? if region-level we can try provisioning in ap-south1 or fallback to us-west-2 for critical jobs.

alex k: looks region-level for ap-southeast1. Short-term mitigation: 1) divert canary traffic to us-west-2 pools, 2) enable spot fallback for non-SLA workloads, 3) drain any idle nodes and reclaim GPUs. Doing (1) now via routing policy change.

infra-bot: Autoscaler: applied routing override for model-route:llm-heavy -> region:us-west-2. Triggered 3 scale actions. Logs: `scale_trigger id=st-789 action=route_override` :eyes:

sana: thanks for the quick pivot. For Dedicated customers that pinned region, do they get notified automatically? we should avoid surprises.

tess: they get email alerts for region failover only if the customer has failover opt-in. Can you add a note to the incident config for today? I can help draft.

alex k: will add a note. also opened internal ticket RG-342 to track: quota increase request, customer comms, and a short-term autoscaler tweak. PR up for the routing rollback safety net: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412 (needs review). can someone look? small change in routing policy priority.

pranav: i'll take the PR — will review in ~30m. Also sending a quick script to scan other projects/regions for quota headroom:

pranav: ```
# quick quota check
gcloud compute regions describe ap-southeast1 --project=my-redwood-prod | grep -i gpu -A2
```

alex k: perfect. action items: alex -> submit follow-up to cloud support for quota bump (done), tess -> update incident-runbook note & customer comm draft, pranav -> review PR + scan other regions, sana -> confirm which Dedicated customers are pinned to ap-southeast1 and whether we should auto-failover.

sana: will start a quick list and post in #support after this thread. also toggling higher alert severity for any new provisioning failures :pray:

infra-bot: Alert: provisioning_failures.apac count=6 window=15m severity=warning

tess: thanks all. quick Q: should we also relax the autoscaler hard floor for a short window so reclaimed idle nodes can be rapidly replaced? might help while quota is pending.

alex k: yes I'll flip the floor to 0.6 for 1h and set a rollback at +2h. Doing now.

pranav: reviewed the PR, minor nits, approved. will merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:

alex k: closing loop — routing override active, email to cloud support submitted, RG-342 created. Will update when quota bump approved or if we see more failures. Ping me for handoff if anyone is going on PTO.
